content.title: About
content.content: Baby Toddler green beans, Stage 2 are gently cooked snap beans designed for children aged 8 to 12 months. They are rich in vitamins, minerals, and dietary fiber, and have a mild flavor that is easily accepted by small stomachs.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Green beans are one of the first vegetables introduced to infants as purees or finely chopped pieces.
The beans provide plant protein that supports growth and tissue development.
In Stage 2 the beans are partially softened but retain small pieces to develop chewing skills.
Green beans are high in folate, important for nervous system development in babies.
They contain antioxidants that help protect cells from oxidative stress.

items.title: Rich in vitamin C
items.content: Vitamin C supports the immune system and enhances iron absorption from plant foods.

items.title: Source of folate
items.content: Folate is essential for proper nervous system development and DNA synthesis.

items.title: Contains dietary fiber
items.content: Fiber promotes healthy digestion and helps establish a beneficial gut microbiome.

items.title: Low in sodium
items.content: Low sodium levels make the product safe for a developing infant who is not ready for high salt intake.

items.title: Plant protein
items.content: Protein from beans supports muscle growth and tissue development in toddlers.

items.title: Legume allergy
items.content: Some children may develop an allergy to legumes; monitor for reactions when first introduced.

items.title: Choking hazard
items.content: Bean pieces should be soft and finely cut to prevent choking in children under 12 months.

items.title: Food contamination
items.content: Product must be stored in a sealed package and be heat‑treated to eliminate bacterial risks.

items.title: Oxalate content
items.content: Green beans contain small amounts of oxalates; children prone to kidney stones should have limited intake.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Serve the beans as soft pieces or puree mixed with breast milk, infant formula, or a small amount of vegetable broth. For beginners, mash the beans with a fork before offering.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep the package in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. After opening, store in an airtight container in the refrigerator and use within 3 days.
